descriptions.zh:
**请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 PDS 的收费方式和[价格](~~425220~~)**。

使用此功能须开通增值服务图片处理功能。

用户传入指定故事的 id，以获取该故事的详情。
descriptions.en:
**Before calling this operation, ensure you understand the billing methods and [pricing](~~425220~~) of PDS**.

You must activate the image processing value-added service to use this feature.

This operation retrieves the details of a story.
